hypothesis_under_test: owner B2: the registered statistics measure vein PLACEMENT (seed-controlled), not material chromaticity (family-controlled); a placement-invariant distributional statistic should collapse the seed-only floor. Tested, not adopted: if invariance does not collapse the floor the diagnosis is wrong and gets said plainly.
chroma_definition_fixed: per-pixel chroma c = (max(R,G,B) - min(R,G,B)) / (max(R,G,B) + min(R,G,B) + 1e-9) on scene-linear RGB (exposure-invariant saturation); hue = standard hue angle; all statistics over the POWDER region mask only

candidates_all_named_now.C1_CHROMA_QUANTILE_SPREAD: p95(c) - p5(c) over the field — distributional, placement-invariant
candidates_all_named_now.C2_CHROMA_HISTOGRAM_L1: pairwise: L1 distance between 64-bin normalized histograms of c (field vs field) — placement-invariant
candidates_all_named_now.C3_HUE_CIRCULAR_STD: chroma-weighted circular standard deviation of hue over the field (weights = c, no threshold knob) — placement-invariant
candidates_all_named_now.C4_MEAN_CHROMA: field mean of c — first moment, placement-invariant
candidates_all_named_now.C5_REGISTERED_REFERENCE: the standing MARBLE_CHROMA_SPAN — kept as the diagnosed-defective comparator for the hypothesis test; not a candidate for counting

controls_mandatory_both.negative: seed-only floor over the 6-seed marbled ensemble (15 pairings, max estimator): the statistic must FAIL to distinguish same-material seed variants — eligibility bar floor < 0.25, required clearing max(0.25, 2x floor)
controls_mandatory_both.positive: LIVE fixture: cool-shade MARBLED vs cool-shade solid (POWDER_MATTE) must show effect >= 0.25 — a pair known chromatically different by construction post-C6

choice_criterion_before_numbers: among candidates passing BOTH controls: the TWO with the lowest seed-only floors; ties broken by larger positive-control effect; discards reported with their numbers. If fewer than two qualify, the re-rule proceeds with what qualifies and reports the two-axis law consequence honestly.
re_rule_terms: SOLID_VS_MARBLED re-ruled (never restored) on the warm pair (ens_500 vs mb_solid_warm) under the FULL amended law; all readings start NOT_ESTABLISHED_PENDING_SPREAD (a new instrument inherits neither verdict nor establishment); pairwise statistics (C2) read with the same member roles on both sides
zero_renders: all inputs are retained frames from the post-repair commissioning run
